sentences.text: 22.03.2023 Order No. CRLMC No.871 of 2023 & I.A. No. 606 of 2023 01.

1. Heard Mr. K. Mohanty, learned counsel for the petitioner.
2.

This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the petitioner challenging the order dated 26.04.2018 passed by the learned S.D.J.M., Titlagarh in G.R. Case No. 317 of 2017 arising out of Titlagarh P.S. Case No. 226 of 2017 taking cognizance of offences punishable under Sections 420/294/506/354 of the I.P.C.
3.

Mr. Mohanty, learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner has instituted 1CC Case No. 14 of 2018 where cognizance of offences punishable under Sections 408/420/506 of the I.P.C. has been taken and summons issued to the informant.

He also submits that in the meanwhile,
the dispute between the parties has been amicably settled between them and the informant,
opposite party no.2 does not wish to proceed against the petitioner in the present case.

Considering the above submission, issue notice to opposite parties in the CRLMC as well as in the I.A.

6. Notice on behalf of opposite party no.1-State is accepted by Ms. S. Patnaik, learned Additional Government Advocate.
Requisites for issuance of notice to opposite party no.2 by Registered Post with A.D returnable within four weeks, shall be filed by 27.03.2023.
One set of process fee shall be accepted.

7. List this matter in the week commencing on 15.05.2023.
8.
Ms. S. Patnaik, learned Additional Government Advocate shall obtain instructions regarding amicable settlement of the case between the parties.
9. In the meanwhile, further proceeding in G.R. Case No. 317 of 2017 pending in the Court of learned S.D.J.M., Titlagarh shall remain stayed till the next date.
Urgent certified copy of this order be granted on proper application.
